description: Published vector values that changed between mvp-0.4-baseline.1 and mvp-0.4-baseline.2, each with the decision that approved it. Checked by scripts/check-baseline-changes.mjs; any other changed or removed value fails validation.

changed.rule: Corpus defect found by the server task LFCP-04-408 (orchestrator, 2026-11-04; task LFCP-04-403c): READY_identity_01 was generated with envelope type 1 (CHALLENGE) and wire profile "lfcp-1", so its bytes were not a READY message (LFCP-WIRE-01 §33, §37). It now uses type 3 (READY) and the profile "LFCP-WIRE-01" of every other READY in the corpora; field 5 ["identity-01"], the Message ID, the correlation and the other READY fields are unchanged.
